privacy.body:
Who we are

Salem Binmaskin Solutions (“we”, “us”) is a technology company based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. This policy describes how we handle personal data when you use this website or contact us.

UAE Personal Data Protection

We process personal data in line with applicable UAE law, including Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 on the Protection of Personal Data (PDPL), and related guidance.

What we collect

  • Contact details you submit (name, email, phone, message content).
  • Technical data needed to display this site (standard browser requests).

Why we use data

To respond to inquiries, deliver services you request, maintain security of our systems, and meet legal or regulatory obligations in the UAE.

Sharing

We do not sell personal data. We may share information with service providers acting on our instructions, or when required by UAE law or competent authorities.

Retention

Inquiry data is kept only as long as needed to handle your request and for reasonable business or legal records, then deleted or anonymised.

Your rights

Subject to PDPL and applicable law, you may request access, correction, deletion, or restriction of processing. Contact us at info@binmaskin.solutions.

Contact

Salem Binmaskin Solutions · Dubai, United Arab Emirates · info@binmaskin.solutions · +971 50 231 6702 · Trade licence 1395363 · Dubai Chamber 552755

This page is for general information and does not constitute legal advice.

security.body:
How we contact you

Salem Binmaskin Solutions only uses the email, phone and WhatsApp number published on this website. We will not ask you to switch to a private number, a personal inbox, or a chat app that is not listed here.

We never ask for money this way

We will never ask you to send cash, cryptocurrency, gift cards, or a transfer to a personal bank account. We do not request payment over WhatsApp, SMS, or a sudden email that is not from @binmaskin.solutions.

  • No payment before a written scope and a company invoice.
  • Bank details appear on that invoice only — not in a chat.
  • We do not ask you to “confirm a fee” to release a contract, visa, or document.

We never ask for

  • Passwords, one-time codes (OTP), bank PINs, or remote-access software.
  • Urgency that forbids you from calling the number on this site.
  • Copies of identity or trade documents except through an agreed, documented process.

Verify a genuine request

  • Website: binmaskin.solutions
  • Email: info@binmaskin.solutions
  • Phone / WhatsApp: +971 50 231 6702
  • Trade licence 1395363 · Dubai Chamber 552755

If a message uses a look-alike domain, a different WhatsApp number, or asks you to keep the conversation secret — it is not us.

If something feels off

Do not pay. Do not share codes. Call or email the contacts on this page, and forward the message to info@binmaskin.solutions.

This page is for general information. Report fraud to the relevant UAE authorities when needed.
